title: eat shit & die 173
author: bpatrick
body: I may have gone too far with this one – but I think it’s funny so here it is. This actually usually happens to me (although not to this extreme) with a girlfriend/girl friend in the loud-mouth role but that situation precludes the punch line here and ends with me looking like a coward while secretly siding with our adversaries.

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.text:
Dude, this is great. Totally a standout, in fact (best comeuppance ever, too). This is like Classic Akimbo; there’s no other webcomic that would do something like this, so good on yer.
(this one deserves some better jpeg compression, incidentally. Are you able to adjust that at all in whatever program you’re using? Sorry, i just always notice stuff like that, i don’t mean to distract from what is an amazing comic!)

comments.author: David
comments.text: This is awesome, and yes, classic Akimbo. Not too far, either, not that I’d mind if it were.
